h1: Custom Cardboard Awards for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom cardboard awards for bulk events. Eco-friendly, cost-effective, and fully customizable at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cardboard awards offer a lightweight, budget-friendly alternative for recognition events where sustainability matters. Unlike heavier materials, these awards are easy to ship and store in bulk, making them ideal for large team acknowledgments or promotional giveaways. Decorate with full-color print or foil stamping for a polished look that still feels approachable. Perfect for safety milestones, service anniversaries, or fun internal competitions.
heroAltText: Custom cardboard awards with full-color print and foil stamping for corporate recognition events
